source.venue: Haluk Elver Salonu 1/2/3 (real supplied venue plan #2)
source.layout: Banquet — numbered round tables, 12 pax each

document.note: ORNEK.pdf contains no text and no vector geometry — one /DCTDecode image and nothing else. ornek-raw.jpg is that stream copied out byte for byte; ornek-upright.png is the same pixels rotated 270 degrees and nothing else. Both are produced by benchmarks/plans/extract-ornek.mjs.

representation.why: Tables are numbered circles standing for tables, not drawings of table furniture, and no chair is drawn anywhere on the sheet. Capacity is stated as a rule (166 * 12) rather than being countable from drawn seats. This is decided from what the document shows, not from its file extension: the Golden Plan is a PDF-free raster too and is PHYSICAL.
representation.contrastWithPlanOne: merit-real-venue draws 113 individual chairs and its capacity is countable from them. Nothing about this plan is a second copy of that problem.

annotationMethod:
HUMAN-REVIEWED. Not machine-regenerable, and deliberately so.

Circle proposals came from benchmarks/annotate/ornek-circle-finder.mjs, which
shares no code and no reasoning with the detector under test — if the product's
own detector had proposed this ground truth, the benchmark would be measuring
the detector against itself and every number in it would be meaningless.

Every proposal was then checked by eye against zoomed crops of the real pixels:
27 were rejected as sitting on objects the plan draws for another purpose (the
four 'servant' bars, the wall pillars, the capacity text box, the wide grey
stage bar, the SYSTEM KONTROL block and its arrows, the LOCA strip); 4 tables
the finder's threshold stage could not see were added after being confirmed in
a crop — the row of 72-75 is printed so faintly (interior ~241 grey against
paper ~253) that no per-pixel threshold reaches it; and one circle a full row
below the last table row, sitting on the bottom-left 'servant' bar between two
already-rejected proposals, was rejected on the same grounds as its neighbours.

Every printed table number below was read by eye, row by row, from crops at
1.7-4x. Centres are the finder's, re-centred on the matched-filter optimum and
then snapped to their own row's least-squares line (the sheet was photographed
slightly rotated, so each row is straight but tilted); the largest snap was
17px, and the result was re-checked against the pixels at 1.7x.

The count reached this way — 157 numbered plus 9 dark-filled — is 166, which is
independently what the drawing itself prints (SALON : 166). That agreement is a
corroboration and is recorded as one; it was not used to derive the count. The
one circle removed on count grounds was removed because of where it sits, not
because 167 was the wrong number.

confidence.tables: high — 166 circles, each confirmed in a zoomed crop, count corroborated by the drawing's own printed SALON figure
confidence.tableNumbers: high for the 157 legible ones — each read by eye at 1.7-4x, and they form 1..157 with no gap and no duplicate
confidence.darkTableNumbers: none — the 9 dark-filled tables carry printing, but at this scan resolution it is not legible even under local contrast stretching at 8x. Recorded as unknown rather than guessed.
confidence.centres: within roughly 10px of the visible disc centre
confidence.regions: measured where marked so; the rest read at low zoom and marked approximate

notes:
Real supplied venue plan #2. A PHOTOGRAPHED PRINTOUT, not a clean export:
rotated 90 degrees in the container, with a fold line down the sheet, camera
shadow, slight perspective and paper texture throughout.

ZERO chairs are drawn on this plan. Any chair the detector reports here is a
false positive, and 'chairs recalled' is not a meaningful measure on it.

The 9 dark-filled circles are tables too: they are the same size as the others,
sit in the same rows, and 157 numbered + 9 filled is exactly the 166 the sheet
prints. What their fill means operationally is not stated anywhere on the
drawing and is NOT recorded here as if it were known.

These printed values are ground truth for this benchmark and nothing else.
No production code may branch on this file's name, its hash, or these numbers.

capacity.annotatedChairsNote: Zero, and that is the plan's own content, not a gap in the annotation: this drawing shows no chairs at all. Capacity here is a printed RULE applied to a table count, not a sum over drawn seats.
derivable: 166 tables x 12 pax = 1992, which is the seating figure the drawing prints
1992 + 72 loca pax = 2064, which is the total the drawing prints
the 12 LOCA cells along the strip, at 6 pax each, would give the printed 72 — the 6 is NOT printed anywhere and is therefore not asserted here
capacity.note: The relationship 166 x 12 = 1992 is what the product should be able to state and attribute. It must reach it from the document, never from a constant.

loca.discrepancy: The strip reads 8A and the index reads 'Loca 8'. That inconsistency is in the source document; it is recorded as found and NOT corrected here.
loca.perLocaPaxNote: not printed on the drawing; 72/12 = 6 is arithmetic, not evidence, and is not asserted
